description: This file implements the FSIO (Flexible Sensor Input/Output) interface for a microcontroller-based engine management system. It contains definitions for handling GPIO pins, configuring PWM outputs, processing expressions for output logic, and integrating various vehicle sensor signals and control outputs such as relays, fans, and servo controls. Additionally, it provides functions for interacting with external configuration via console commands and handles real-time updates of output states based on sensor inputs and logic expressions.

classes.name: FsioPointers
classes.description: A helper class that holds pointers to FSIO logic elements for different command types.

classes.name: LENameOrdinalPair
classes.description: A data structure pairing a logic element's name with its ordinal value used for identifying sensor/method mappings.

classes.name: LECalculator
classes.description: Performs evaluation of logic expressions to compute output values.

classes.name: LEElement
classes.description: Represents an element in a logic expression tree used for evaluating sensor logic or control expressions.

classes.name: LEElementPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of LEElements for parsing and evaluating logic expressions.

classes.name: OutputPin
classes.description: Abstracts a hardware output pin, providing methods to set output logic states.

methods.name: setFsio
methods.description: Configures an FSIO output pin with a specific expression.

methods.name: setFsioExt
methods.description: Sets an FSIO output with a specific pin, formula, and PWM frequency.

methods.name: applyFsioConfiguration
methods.description: Applies the current configuration of FSIO logic expressions to internal data structures.

methods.name: onConfigurationChangeFsioCallback
methods.description: Callback triggered when FSIO configuration changes, reapplying the configuration.

methods.name: runFsio
methods.description: Main periodic function that evaluates sensor inputs and updates FSIO outputs accordingly.

methods.name: showFsioInfo
methods.description: Displays current FSIO configuration and states for diagnostics.

methods.name: setFsioSetting
methods.description: Sets a numeric property value for a specific FSIO configuration index.

methods.name: setFsioExpression
methods.description: Sets a custom logic expression for a specific FSIO output index.

methods.name: rpnEval
methods.description: Evaluates a Reverse Polish Notation expression and outputs the result.

methods.name: initFsioImpl
methods.description: Initializes the FSIO system, setting up logic elements and console commands.
